I thought I would share my experience with the RE-71R's on my FRS. I got the tire in 235/45 17. ~$740 installed through discount tire.

First off here is a few images of the tires on the car. https://imgur.com/a/bV6GT

The good:

Warm up quick when driving hard. Grip harder than I have the balls to push. 200 treadwear. Looks so much better than stock. It has that boxy tire look.

The bad:

Slips as bad as the stock tire when cold. It takes 5-10 minutes of street driving to get warm. Really bad in the wet. Slips and slides like you're driving on sand. Much worse than I thought it would be. I haven't hydroplaned yet..

Conclusion:

Worth it.

I have only had the tire for about 1,000 miles so keep that in mind. I do think it will be the most sticky tire I'll ever put on the car and DD. I do think this tire will last as long as the stock due to how I drive. The stock tire was spinning and sliding so often that it was going to make it about 15k-20k miles. The RE-71R's will be somewhere around 15k I'd guess.
